use_deterministic_algorithms: create a python module to enable or disable deterministic algorithms in PyTorch with optional warning mode
create_rngbag_from_generators: build a python module to create an RngBag holding multiple PyTorch random number generators
create_rngbag_from_devices: build a python module to create an RngBag from default generators of CPU or CUDA devices
seed_rngbag: create a python module to set all generators in an RngBag to a random seed or a specific manual seed
temporary_manual_seed_context: create a python module to temporarily seed an RngBag within a context manager and restore original states
